timeline.evidenceText: They went up by the South, and came to Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
Caleb drove out the three sons of Anak: Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
Judah went against the Canaanites who lived in Hebron. (The name of Hebron before that was Kiriath Arba.) They struck Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.
and his second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;
But Absalom fled, and went to Talmai the son of Ammihur, king of Geshur. David mourned for his son every day.

definitions.short: Talmai , the name of a Canaanite and a Syrian
definitions.full: H8526. Talmay תַּלְמַי proper name, masculine 1. king of Geshur, father-in-law of David , 2Sam 3:3 ; 13:37 ; 1Chr 3:2 . 2 a son of `Anak Num 13:22 ; Josh 15:14 , תַּלְמָ֑י Judg 1:10 ; Θομμει , Θολμει , Θαλαμειν , etc. תַּלְמִיד see למד . [ תְּלֻנָּה ] see II. לון תלע (√ of following; perhaps gnaw , see מְתַלְּעוֺת infra, and Dl Pr 113 , compare As tultu, worm ).
